notes.title: My new game Zefyr is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
🎉Finally, it’s here ✨ After 12 years of crazy and naïve solo dev, my game Zefyr is officially released!

[h1]👇 Get it now ! 👇[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344990
I’m incredibly happy, grateful, and super stressed at the same time. I truly hope you’ll enjoy it! Here’s some quick info:

[h1]1 — Please leave a positive review[/h1] 
...if you enjoyed the game or course! It really helps a lot to boost visibility and reach more players.

[h1]2 — Support Bundles Available[/h1]
For those who want to support the project even more, I’ve created a few bundles that you can all find on the game page:
[list]
[*] [b]Zefyr Soundtrack Edition[/b]: Game + soundtrack
[*] [b]Zefyr Supporter Edition[/b]: Game + soundtrack + artworks + HD in-game paintings + the very first build from 12 years ago
[*] [b]All My Games[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1344990/Zefyr_A_Thiefs_Melody/]Zefyr[/url] + [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1345280/Slide__Animal_Race/]Slide[/url] (racing game with cute animals) + [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1630740/Silent_Night__A_Christmas_Delivery/]Silent Night[/url] (ride Santa’s sleigh in a chill scoring game)
[*] [b]All My Games Supporter Edition[/b]: Everything above (all games/soundtracks/supporter packs)
[/list]
Feel free to choose one of these instead of the base edition!

[h1]3 — Playable on Steam Deck[/h1]
The game runs well on Steam Deck, even if it doesn't have the official badge yet. More details about game settings here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1344990/view/542229787451589252

[h1]4 — Follow me
[/h1]If you don't want to miss anything of my future updates and upcoming games, you can:
[list]
[*] Follow my Steam dev page: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/oneiricworlds
[*] Follow me on Discord, Bluesky, Reddit, YouTube, Threads, Instagram, and more: [url=All my social networks]https://linktr.ee/oneiricworlds[/url]
[/list]

[h2]🙏Thank you SO much for the amazing support over the years.🙏[/h2] 
Your feedback and kind messages truly kept me going.

Wishing you all the best — take care, and see you soon with updates and fixes!
Have a wonderful day (and please don’t forget to leave a review!)

Mathias, the (tired) dev
